about.title: What is YourHEI
about.text: YourHEI helps applicants and their families find a university, college, school or language courses in the Caucasus, Central Asia, Eastern Europe, Europe and Asia. Tell us about yourself and we will suggest suitable options and show what is still missing for admission.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Create an account and tell us your country, age and documents.
how.step2Text: Answer questions about your goals, grades, languages and budget.
how.step3Text: Receive a list of safe, suitable and ambitious options.

about.title: About the project
about.body: YourHEI is a project that helps people choose where to study. It is under development: right now only the map with test data is available.

privacy.intro: This template explains which data YourHEI collects and why. It is not final: a lawyer must review it before the site is launched.
privacy.s1Text: YourHEI is a project that helps applicants choose where to study. Contact details for questions about your data will be published here before launch.
privacy.s2Text: Only what matching needs: e-mail and password (the password is stored only as a secure hash, never as text), date of birth, gender (you may choose not to say), country of residence, citizenships, what you are looking for, and the status of your documents. We do not collect copies of your documents.
privacy.s3Text: Date of birth and country of residence are used to check the minimum age in your country. Citizenship, residence and documents are used to show visa rules and what is missing for admission. Gender matters for single-sex schools and dormitories. Your e-mail is used to sign in and for service messages.
privacy.s4Text: Data is stored with our database provider (Supabase) until you delete your account. Access rules let each person see only their own data.
privacy.s5Text: In your profile you can edit all your data, download a copy and delete your account with all data. Deletion happens immediately and cannot be undone. News and tips by e-mail are sent only if you ticked the optional box, and you can turn them off in your profile.
privacy.s6Text: We register people only from the minimum age of their country of residence (14, 16 or 18, depending on the country). If you are younger, no account is created and nothing you typed is stored.
privacy.s7Text: The site uses no analytics, advertising or third-party trackers. It keeps only technical data in your browser: your language, your theme and your login session. A cookie banner will be added before any analytics or advertising is switched on.

terms.intro: This template describes the rules of using YourHEI. It is not final: a lawyer must review it before the site is launched.
terms.s1Text: YourHEI shows educational institutions on a map and suggests options based on your answers. At this stage it is free.
terms.s2Text: Give true information and keep your password secret. One person, one account. You must have reached the minimum age of your country of residence.
terms.s3Text: Data about institutions comes from open sources and may be outdated or incomplete. Always check the official website before you apply. A suggestion is not a promise of admission.
terms.s4Text: Do not misuse the service: no automated mass collection of data, no attempts to break it, no false reports.
terms.s5Text: We may change the service and these terms; important changes will be announced on the site. You can delete your account at any time.
terms.s6Text: The service is provided as it is. Limits of liability and the governing law will be added after a lawyer has reviewed this text.

riasec.intro: Rate each statement from 1 to 5. There are no right or wrong answers.

items.0: I like to fix or build things with my hands or tools.
items.1: I like to figure out how something works by experimenting or analysing data.
items.2: I like to create something original: write, draw, design or compose.
items.3: I like to help, teach or take care of other people.
items.4: I like to lead a team or persuade others to follow my idea.
items.5: I like to organise information, keep records and follow clear procedures.
items.6: I enjoy working outdoors, with machines, animals or plants.
items.7: I enjoy solving a hard puzzle or a maths problem.
items.8: I like to express ideas through music, theatre or visual media.
items.9: I am good at listening to people and supporting them in hard times.
items.10: I like to start a project or a business and take risks.
items.11: I like to plan budgets, schedules and details so that everything runs exactly right.
